primary_effort: Make the established landing-to-rebound pattern repeatable across short sets without adding impact or complexity.
readiness_gate: Use the same controllable amplitude and support conditions as the most recent actual qualified exposure, if recorded. Otherwise select a conservative controllable amplitude within the listed attempts today; do not claim that Class 1 established it. No jump progression is prescribed. A load increase on P1 alone is optional only after actual prior clean 2 × 5 completion at the intended RIR, acceptable subsequent response and current readiness; otherwise hold or calibrate downward.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 jumps.** Controlled submaximal height; **20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Repeat the same terminal braking pattern before asking for rebounds. Use a smooth dip and arm swing, jump vertically, then let ankles, knees and hips yield together and hold 2 s. Keep pressure centered over both feet. Reduce height if the landing needs a step or the trunk folds; stop if control is not restored.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 8 low jumps**, continuous; **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Rehearse ankle-led elastic return with little hip/knee excursion before the larger multi-joint task. Stay tall, knees soft, feet under hips; rebound briskly without chasing height. Let the final landing settle. Reduce amplitude for heavy contacts or knee pumping; stop for persistent loss of rhythm.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps
explosive.dose: **3 × 3 jumps = 9 jumps and 6 rebound transitions.** **120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary anchor, unchanged protocol:** accept landing momentum and reverse promptly through the ankle, knee and hip. Use a natural arm swing and a repeatable moderate height; jump 2 follows landing 1 and jump 3 follows landing 2 without resetting. Land after jump 3 and hold 2 s. Allow necessary joint flexion; do not lock the knees or force pogo mechanics onto a larger jump. Lower amplitude if a second dip, collapse or drift develops.

explosive.name: Broad Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 jumps.** Modest forward distance with a brisk two-foot takeoff; **20 s between jumps; 90 s before E5.**
explosive.job: Absorb a forward component of momentum that E1/E3 do not provide. Land on two feet, bring the hips over the base and hold 2 s without shuffling. Reset by walking only after the area is clear. Shorten distance if the athlete falls forward or reaches the feet far ahead of the body.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — stick landing
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 landings per leg = 4 bounds.** Alternate receiving legs, fully resetting each time. **20 s between bounds; 90 s before E6.**
explosive.job: Accept lateral momentum on one leg while controlling the pelvis, knee and foot. Push from one leg to the other over a small distance, absorb and hold 2 s; this is a bound, not a side-step drill. Reduce distance for pelvic drop, knee collapse or a corrective hop.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 5 low hops per leg = 10 hops.** **60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Apply a small ankle rebound dose with the load carried by one support leg, after the main bilateral work. Keep the foot beneath the pelvis and knee softly organized; settle the fifth landing. Reduce hop height if the ankle rolls or the free leg flails. End the set if this remains uncontrolled.

replacement_routes.description: E3 two-jump replacement: use 3 × 2 instead of 3 × 3; 34 landings = 20 bilateral + 14 single-leg, 18 rebound transitions, 54 limb contacts. E3 takes approximately 375 s versus 378 s; the same overall time allowance remains sufficient.

next_intended_job: Class 3 may examine a small self-generated amplitude increase in the existing vertical rebound only after actual readiness evidence; otherwise repeat the existing height.
